description: Reviews API: Search App Store apps. Apps of one country's App Store matching a name, developer or keyword, as `Entity` objects (`type` app). Price: 8 credits per call; failed calls are free. Paginated: pass pagination.next_cursor as `cursor` for the next page (each page is a new call).

country.description: Store country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2): apps and reviews differ per country
